Nominal ARS effective yield — all peso bonds

Every type on one axis, by maturity. Switch scenario to see the curve move.

LECAP/BONCAPCERTAMARBONTEUSD-LinkedDual/TAMAR

49 peso bonds — LECAP/BONCAP, CER, TAMAR, BONTE, dollar-linked and BONCER DUAL — with every cash flow projected into nominal ARS so all types share one axis. Hard-dollar bonds (NY law, Argentine law, BOPREAL) are excluded. Each BONCER DUAL shows only the leg that pays more under the selected scenario (·C = CER leg, ·T = TAMAR leg). The scale is set from each scenario’s own P10–P90 spread, so every view is fitted to its own data — the y-axis rescales when you switch scenario. A bond days from maturity, whose annualised yield explodes, cannot flatten the rest of the curve: any such bond is drawn as a hollow triangle on the axis edge with its true yield in the label.
